title: Vector and Machine
author: Lena Oyelaran
blurb: Ines Underhill, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
